newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Texaco Rotterdam refining returns to full capacity.
newsitem.headline: Texaco Rotterdam refining returns to full capacity.

text.p: Texaco Inc has restored crude throughput at its Nerefco refineries to full capacity, trade sources said on Monday.
Texaco returned to full capacity in the latter part of last week. It has been running at 20 percent below normal since the middle of May when margins for complex refining fell below $1.50 per barrel.
The two Nerefco refineries, with a combined capacity of 420,000 barrels per day, are 35 percent owned by Texaco and 65 percent by BP.
Shell and BP also cut runs at their Rotterdam operations late in May, but returned to normal at the start of June.
Last week, refining margins in Rotterdam reached their highest levels in seven months, according to Reuters data using standard product yields.
On Friday, the Brent cracking margin stood at $2.96 a barrel compared to a previous peak of $3.62 last October.
